title: Mantis Shrimp Punches Break Physics
hook: You think you're fast, but this tiny animal breaks physics
script: Meet the animal that defies speed limits The mantis shrimp punches so fast Its speed creates a flash of light and heat What fuels this explosive power? The mantis shrimp's claw accelerates rapidly But that's not even the strange part It briefly boils the water around its claw Creating a blast that's both fierce and tiny This phenomenon is hiding in plain sight A secret world of intense energy The mantis shrimp's punch is a natural wonder Save this and remember the mantis shrimp's boiling punch
